messages:
mia_product: Quick sync — PRD draft for "Consumption Guardrails" (quotas, soft/hard limits, metering semantics, and billing behaviors). I sketched three scope options. Need product + eng + finance signoff on launch criteria and edge cases by EOD Friday.

devin_eng: ACK. Can you paste the three scope options here?

mia_product: Sure — short:
1) Minimal: API-only quotas (per-key, simple numeric limit), hard-enforced, no UI, overage blocked.
2) Standard: API + Console (view + set limits), soft limits with alerts + configurable overage billing, per-route overrides.
3) Full: All above + predictive suggestions (Optimize integration), multi-tenant admin UI, grace windows, and per-model quotas.

ashley_bizops: From billing POV we prefer Standard or Full. Minimal blocks customers and increases CS tickets. Need clear semantics for "overage" vs "throttled" and immediate invoicing rules.

frank_finance: +1. Acceptance criteria we need: clear metering unit (tokens vs requests), alignment with billing cycles, and a reconciliation test harness. Also define invoice line items: "quota addendum" vs usage overage. No retroactive charges without notification window.

ranjit_api: Tech notes:
- Metering must be token-level for generation & embeddings (different multipliers).
- API should expose quota headers: `X-Quota-Limit`, `X-Quota-Used`, `X-Quota-Reset`.
- Endpoint draft:
```
POST /v1/quotas
{
  "org_id":"org_123",
  "limit_type":"tokens_per_day",
  "limit":1000000,
  "behavior":"soft_notify" // options: hard_block, soft_notify, overage_charge
}
```
- Edge: streaming responses should decrement usage as tokens are emitted, not on response end.

lenore_design: UI thoughts — Console needs two quick views: Admin (set org-wide limits + billing toggles) and App-level (view usage, request increases). Show projected burn rate with a 7d sparkline and a red/amber/green indicator. For soft limits add a prominent CTA: "Request increase".

mia_product: Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Must support per-org and per-api-key limits.
- Metering units: tokens for text+chat, embedding-requests counted separately. Document multipliers in PRD.
- Soft limit path: notify + allow configurable grace (0/1/24h) then optional overage billing if enabled.
- Hard limit path: immediate 429 with standard `quota_exceeded` code and header explaining reset time.
- Console: view usage, set limits, and configure behavior (hard/soft/overage). Must include billing summary.
- E2E test: simulated 10 tenants with mixed traffic for 48h; reconciliation delta < 0.5%.

devin_eng: Edge cases:
- Shared API keys across apps -> limits apply to the key (not org) unless org override present.
- Concurrent requests and KV race: we need atomic decrement or token-bucket on the leader to avoid negative counts.
- Model switching mid-stream: if runtime falls back to cheaper model, billing must still account for tokens consumed by chosen model; UI should show model-level breakdown.

ashley_bizops: Overage pricing semantics:
- Default: no automatic overage charge (opt-in). If opted-in, apply volume-tiered overage rate starting at 120% of plan rate and prorate to billing cycle.
- Need opt-in audit trail in Console.

ranjit_api: Implementation note: prefer leaky-bucket on the serving side + periodic lease reconciliation with billing ledger. Add header for `X-Quota-Warning` when >90%.

ops-bot: deploy check — quota service canary completed on staging at 2026-03-18T09:12Z, 0 regressions in basic throttle tests.

mia_product: Launch gating (must-have before GA):
- API semantics + docs
- Console set/view + audit trail
- Billing integration + invoice line tests
- E2E reconciliation harness
- Canary rollout plan and rollback path

lenore_design: Small UX edgecases:
- Show an explainer when an org has both per-key and per-org limits which one wins.
- Visual timeline for grace windows + scheduled starts.

frank_finance: Also require a sandbox billing mode so customers can opt into overage in a test org without live billing effect.

devin_eng: Timeline ask — if we go Standard scope (API+Console+Soft limits) we can target alpha in 5 sprints. Minimal is 2 sprints. Full is ~9 sprints.

mia_product: Decision request: product + eng + finance — please react with :one: for Minimal, :two: for Standard, :three: for Full. I'll compile and lock scope by Friday 17:00 PT.

ranjit_api: :two:
ashley_bizops: :two:
frank_finance: :two:
lenore_design: :two:
devin_eng: :two:
mia_product: thanks — locking Standard unless objections by EOD.
